question: Have you already decided the ending of Re:Zero to some extent? Are there any things where the story has changed somewhat from what you initially planned, such as wanting to bring a character back because they became more popular than expected?
answer:
When I create a story, I decide on the beginning and the end first, and then start writing, so the ending is decided to some extent.

I have the broad outline of the process decided as well, but characters get added while I'm writing, so the way Subaru walks his path changes along the way.

When characters are added, there are naturally more things that have to be depicted on the way toward the ending than there were initially.

Even so, the broad outline of the ending hasn't changed.

If you're asking whether I thought, “The characters from Arcs 7 and 8 in the Empire became popular, so let's bring them back,” that's difficult because there are various constraints.

That said, it's not as though they won't appear at all. There are friendships that have been forged, after all.

As for characters getting more appearances, Petelgeuse was the first character I ever received fan art of, and I was so happy about it that his appearances increased, resulting in Subaru dying an extra two times! (laughs)
